source_identity.aggregate_algorithm: Sort git ls-files for the package source set; calculate SHA-256 for each file; calculate SHA-256 over the resulting lines.

declared_supported_subset: The bounded IS 456 component capabilities declared in docs/verification/indian-code-capability-coverage.json and the maintained public API manifests.
Building Gravity Workflow V1 for its declared one-storey gravity-only workflow and explicit load ledger; it is not a complete building workflow.
Routine Excel Workbench V1 and read-only ETABS snapshot intake within their declared contracts; no ETABS model write-back.
Supplied beam-reinforcement detailing and supported footing end-anchorage cases within their declared applicability checks.
The bounded IS 13920 beam, rectangular-column, and one-plane directional beam-column-joint families declared by the maintained status-semantics evidence.
explicit_exclusions: Automatic code-compliant design of a complete building.
Global structural analysis, lateral-load analysis, dynamic analysis, FEM, stability analysis, and soil-structure interaction.
IS 13920 wall design and seismic foundation design outside the declared supported packets.
IS 875 load generation and IS 1893 seismic-action generation as complete code workflows.
Geotechnical design or verification of soil parameters.
ETABS model mutation, write-back, or automatic acceptance of ETABS results.
Engineering judgment, independent checking, qualified engineering review, or professional approval.
next_required_gates: Create the immutable candidate commit and complete required hosted checks against that exact head.
Complete a separately recorded INDIA-4 qualified engineering review of the supported subset.
Obtain explicit owner authorization before tag creation, package publication, or GitHub Release creation.
